scientific_purpose: Validate alternate decision objectives on the same fresh CheMeleon primary-supervised learner: observed-label MCC, each hypothetical .03/.07/.12 prior, and equal mean utility across those priors. Same nested fits and untouched outer groups. No blind-count-based threshold choice.
selection_rule: Freeze average-prior utility before results. Prefer its equal-seed combined margin policy only if held-out projected MCC improves over observed-label cuts on BOTH UMAP and scaffold under the matching .07 scenario, and mean over .03/.07/.12 improves in both splits. Otherwise retain observed-label policy. This is a decision under explicit scenarios, not a known blind class prevalence or fixed count.
limitations: Hypothetical label shift cannot identify absent weak-primary D6 outcomes. Old incumbent not a model base; broad A4 selection bias remains after representation change. Fit and protocol uncertainty exceeds conditional intervals; learner selected after development inspection.
